purpose: Run the current geometric-fidelity kernel against the supplied surviving-wall photograph composite and derivative reconstruction before autonomous landmark extraction exists.

method.normalization: For selected visible figures, hand depth is normalized in a waist-to-skirt-hem frame: waist=0, skirt hem=1.
method.selection: Four visually inspectable wall figures and four clean derivative figures were used as a first preflight cohort. Landmark extraction was operator-assisted because autonomous landmark detection is not yet implemented.
method.warning: This is not the Brown-A blind autonomous trial and cannot be promoted to a final Court finding. It tests the measurement kernel and whether the supplied images contain a measurable geometric discrepancy.

court_scope.earned: The supplied images contain a repeatable, measurable discrepancy in normalized hand depth within the tested cohort. In the derivative figures the hands sit substantially nearer the skirt hem than in the selected wall figures.
not_earned: The discrepancy generalizes to every figure without a larger autonomous sample.
court_scope.next_required_step: Implement autonomous landmark extraction and registration, enlarge the sample across all comparable figures/registers, then rerun without operator-selected landmarks.
